title: Plantaciones
goal: Read about the plantation economy behind the mines: an early industrial-scale sugar mill sustained by enslaved Africans, and the cacao elite of Caracas and Guayaquil.

items: Explain why export agriculture was the second great pillar of the colonial economy, alongside mining.
Explain why a sugar mill is compared to an early factory.
Describe where sugar was grown and whose forced labor sustained the mills.
Describe the 'grandes cacaos', the Creole landowners of the Caracas and Guayaquil valleys.
